english.detail: Either Korean or English proficiency required; IELTS 6.0 or higher per SNU international admissions FAQ (not stated as undergraduate-only).
TOEFL iBT 80 (alternative to IELTS 6.0 per same FAQ; TEPS 551 also accepted).

universities.notes: Undergrad fee KRW 70,000 per FAQ. International undergrad tuition and 2027 deadlines not found on official pages checked (Spring 2027 guide PDF linked but.
Tuition page says 2026-27 fees 'coming soon'; only 2025-26 national bachelor fee (EUR 178) found, which is not an international rate. Non-EU differentiated.
Bachelor admission is fee-based and open to non-Saudi residents with Saudi residency; no bachelor tuition, fee, English minimum or deadline found on.
International processing fee listed as RM 100 (USD 30) on JOIN UKM. Undergrad English minimum set per programme, not published; no 2027 undergrad closing.
